author: Barry Adams
html:
• He did it! On the 6th of August, our very own Greg Park shaved off his (very) long hair to raise money for the people of Ukraine.

    After his hair was plaited it was cut off and preserved for the people of the Little Princess Trust. They make wigs for children who have lost their own hair through cancer or other conditions, and we're sure they will be happy to receive such a generous donation.

    Then it was time to get the rest shaved off, and after a brush and a spray, Greg was left with a shiny new bald head. We think he looks very handsome - and at least he won't suffer with the heat quite as much as before!

    Most importantly though, at the time of writing, he has raised £1,220 for the British Red Cross Ukraine Crisis Appeal. Since we promised to match donations up to £1,000 that amount will be at least £2,220 and we hope that you will be inspired to donate even more.
